ddl_must_contain: COMPILE USL IF NOT EXISTS crosswalk_usl DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.crosswalk DDL
code varchar(2) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
sic varchar(4) FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES sic_code(code)
station_id varchar(11) NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES station(id)
expected.ddl_statement_count_rule: one statement: the CREATE TABLE parts are separated by ';' inside the DDL and the text has no trailing ';'
description_statements: UPDATE USL lightning.metastore.crosswalk.crosswalk_usl.state SET TABLE DESCRIPTION The 50 states and DC with FIPS codes (seeds/states.json)
UPDATE USL lightning.metastore.crosswalk.crosswalk_usl.state.code SET COLUMN DESCRIPTION USPS two-letter code
UPDATE USL lightning.metastore.crosswalk.crosswalk_usl.state.fips SET COLUMN DESCRIPTION two-digit FIPS state code
expected.description_rule: unquoted text, no semicolon, no apostrophe (an apostrophe is dropped, a semicolon becomes a comma)
